findings.title: Shared rules are not referenced in router or routing guide
findings.evidence: Package contains shared-rules/, but neither SKILL.md nor resources/routing-guide.md references shared-rules, STYLE-GUARDRAILS.md, or ANTI-PATTERNS.md.
findings.impact: Cross-skill routing guidance can miss shared constraints during mini-skill selection.
findings.recommended_follow_up: Update SKILL.md and/or resources/routing-guide.md to reference shared-rules usage in a dedicated remediation issue.

findings.title: Asset-link index omits shared-rules references
findings.evidence: Package contains shared-rules/, but resources/asset-link-index.md does not mention shared-rules, STYLE-GUARDRAILS.md, or ANTI-PATTERNS.md.
findings.impact: Auxiliary index documentation is incomplete for package support files.
findings.recommended_follow_up: Document shared-rules artifacts in resources/asset-link-index.md during remediation.
